findings.title: Missing React key on GrafanaRuleListItem in list map
findings.body: The old GrafanaRuleLoader usage had key={key}, but the new GrafanaRuleListItem element in the 'grafana' case has no key. Elements returned from rules.map without keys trigger React warnings and cause incorrect reconciliation when the list is appended or reordered. Add key={key}.

findings.title: Delete menu item hidden for Grafana rules from list view
findings.body: The Delete item is only rendered when `canDelete && rulerRule`. In the list view only promRule is passed (rulerRule is undefined), so even when grafanaDeleteAbility allows deletion the item never appears. Likewise the Pause item requires rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule), so it is never shown from the list. Those actions are silently lost in the list view.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens from list view
findings.body: The silence drawer renders only when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule), but in the list view rule is undefined. The 'Silence notifications' menu item is shown via the prom ability and sets showSilenceDrawer, yet nothing renders, so clicking it does nothing.

findings.title: Removed tests without replacement; weak coverage
findings.body: The creating and deleting operation tests and the matchRules tests were deleted. The new tests do not cover the delete or pause menu items, which would have exposed that those actions are unreachable from the list view.
